title: Dashboard refresh limits live in two frontend constants
answers: How do I change the minimum time between manual dashboard refreshes?
Where are dashboard auto-refresh interval options defined?
Why is the dashboard refresh button disabled?
body:
Dashboard refresh timing is controlled by two separate constants that are not derived from each other:
- Manual refresh cooldown: `DASHBOARD_MIN_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES` in `frontend/src/scenes/dashboard/dashboardUtils.ts` (now 5). Used to compute `blockRefresh` / `nextAllowedDashboardRefresh` in dashboardLogic.
- Auto-refresh menu choices: `REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS` in `frontend/src/scenes/dashboard/DashboardReloadAction.tsx` (now [900, 1800, 3600]; a 10s option is unshifted only when NODE_ENV is development).
Changing the interval options or cooldown means editing the matching constant. Tests in `frontend/src/scenes/dashboard/dashboardLogic.test.ts` that call `setAutoRefresh(true, <seconds>)` must use a value present in the list. The 'insight refresh' block tests the manual boundary and 'page visibility' tests auto-refresh resume.
applies: Dashboard manual refresh cooldown and auto-refresh interval options in the frontend dashboard scene.
says: Why is the dashboard refresh button staying disabled so long?
How often am I allowed to manually refresh a dashboard?
Where are the auto-refresh timing options configured?
How do I change the minimum wait time between dashboard refreshes?
search: Dashboard refresh timing is controlled by two separate, non-derived constants: manual refresh cooldown (DASHBOARD_MIN_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES in dashboardUtils.ts, default 5 minutes) and auto-refresh menu options (REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS in DashboardReloadAction.tsx, default [900, 1800, 3600] seconds). Editing refresh intervals or cooldown requires updating both constants independently. Tests calling setAutoRefresh() in dashboardLogic.test.ts must use values present in the REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS list, and test hooks validate blockRefresh boundaries ('insight refresh') and page visibility auto-resume. Changes affect the dashboard scene's refresh UI and scheduler behavior.
